licence_proof: dati.puglia.it CKAN package_show for 'elenco-degli-alberi-monumentali-della-regione-puglia': license_id 'CC-BY-4.0', license_title 'Creative Commons Attribution 4.0'. Read 2026-08-16.
scope: 180 monumental trees across Puglia with per-tree GIS coordinates.
caveat: The REGIONAL list, which is richer than the MASAF national file already imported: it carries girth, height, an urban-context flag and the monumentality criteria, where the national file has no age and no vitality. Still no vitality field here either, so alive-now is a per-tree check; the region separately records dead monumental trees, which are not in this file. Cross-check against italy-masaf.json before publishing so the same tree is not entered twice.
